dedupe_keys.name: field measurements on aeolian sediment transport at the sand motor mega nourishment during the megapex field campaign

description: TU Delft provides raw and processed aeolian sediment-transport observations from the six-week MegaPeX campaign at Sand Motor. Eight mobile masts used Wenglor fork-laser and Gill two-dimensional wind sensors. RTK-GPS surveys, erosion pins and sediment traps supply positions, particle counts, topographic changes, wind, precipitation and sediment-transport volumes. Coverage: 2014-09-15/2014-10-24. Access: public native metadata describes the identified resource. Licence: 4TU General Terms of Use. Current file access and cost are unknown. Provider-specific reuse conditions have not been read where general terms apply. Caveats: The campaign tests supply-limited transport at this mega-nourishment and does not establish an unrestricted general sediment model. Units, individual sensor calibration and data completeness are unstated. The custom dates span 15 September to 24 October 2014. Related resources are separately identified in the native collection. The native Sand Motor collection identifies a coastal-protection nourishment and monitoring programme. Simulation use concerns its coastal geometry and sediment or hydrodynamic calibration.
